test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The First elected Parliament of independent India came into existence in -
solution:
The correct answer is __**1952**__.

__
 
• **The first Lok Sabha was constituted on 17 April 1952 after India's first general election**__.

 __
 
• The first Lok Sabha lasted its full term of five years and was dissolved on 4 April 1957.
 
• The first session of this Lok Sabha began on 13 May 1952.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **General elections in India** were held between **25 October 1951 and 21 February 1952**.

 
 
• They were the first elections to the Lok Sabha after independence in August 1947.
 
• The total Lok Sabha seats were 489 and the total eligible voters were 17.3 crores.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
